_header.description: Size budget for the @nop-chaos/flux pack artifact (check:bundle-size, plan 761 / roadmap PH-8). Any metric above baseline * (1 + tolerance) is red. Lower the numbers freely when the artifact shrinks; raising one needs a dated note here.
notes: tarballBytes includes package/dist/index.js.map (10,279,010 B, ~60% of the tarball). Whether source maps ship is a release-strategy decision (roadmap PH-12); dropping them would surface as a tightening hint, not a red.
jsBytes = sum of every .js entry (non-.map) incl. lazy chunks (three-canvas ~1.9 MB, src-* ~1.7 MB). mainEntryBytes = package/dist/index.js only.

2026-10-31 plan 825: mainEntryBytes 5,169,936 → 5,479,361 (+6.0%) — tiptap family bumped off the exact-pinned 3.27.1 generation to ^3.30.5 (resolved 3.32.2; supply-chain advisories GHSA on @tiptap/core <3.30.5 ReDoS + prosemirror-view <1.42.3 XSS) grows the flux-bundle main entry via the bundled form-advanced editor family. Security remediation consciously trades ~300 KB main-entry bytes; re-registered per the gate's dated-note contract (jsBytes/tarball refreshed to live values).
